findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "alkemata-public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: alkemata-get-site-info, alkemata-search-published-content, alkemata-get-published-content · Public sink: alkemata-get-published-content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: alkemata-get-site-info, alkemata-search-published-content, alkemata-get-published-content · Public sink: alkemata-get-published-content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "alkemata-get-site-info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns public identity and interface URLs for Alkemata." → after: "Get the published WordPress site's identity, URLs and language."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
